false_success_traps: A page that reloads the first form with no message about an email is not a confirmation.
A page that shows a captcha error, a "field is required" note, or "try again" after you submit is a failed attempt, not a confirmation.
The "email sent" message only means the link was sent. The request is still waiting. The removal form behind the emailed link still has to be filled in.
The emailed link expires after 24 hours. An unopened link means no request was made.
genuine_confirmation: After the first form, the page says an email with a link was sent. That only starts the request. The request is complete when the form behind the emailed link leads to a page saying the request was received and is being processed, followed by a confirmation email.
name: USPhoneBook

opt_out_url_check.note: The address redirected to https://www.usphonebook.com/removal, which loaded as the "US Phone Book Opt-Out Form". It lists the steps: ask for an emailed link, follow it, fill in the form, see a confirmation page.

steps: Open the US Phone Book opt-out form.
Choose whether you are the person on the listing or an agent acting for them.
On the opt-out form, fill in the first and last name on the listing and an email address you can read.
Tick the box that lets the site email you about the request.
Solve the human check, then press "Begin Removal Process".
Wait for the page to say an email with a link was sent.
Open that email and follow the link within 24 hours. After that the link stops working and you must ask for a new one.
Fill in the form the link opens. The details should match the listing you want removed.
Wait for the page that says the request was received and is being processed. A confirmation email should follow.
Check the listing again after about three days.
